events.title: Tainan City vs Dewa United
events.dataContent:
Tainan City vs Dewa United: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this AFC Challenge League group stage match, in which Taiwanese champions Tainan City host the representative of the Indonesian Super League, Dewa United. This is the historic first official meeting between the two clubs.

Kick-off: October 29, 2025, 12:00 UTC (15:00 MSK)
Stadium: Tainan Municipal Football Stadium, Tainan
Competition: AFC Challenge League

Tainan City vs Dewa United: Match Preview

As the dominant force in their domestic league, Tainan City comes into the match as the favorite, especially considering their home-field advantage. The team has significantly more experience in continental competitions compared to their opponent. Dewa United, making their debut in Asian club tournaments, will be looking to cause an upset. The Indonesian club is a solid mid-table team in their more competitive league and will rely on physical strength and organized defense.

Team Form and Analysis

Tainan City

The 'Steelmen' are multiple champions of Taiwan and regular participants in AFC club tournaments. The team is accustomed to dominating their league, which allows them to play an attacking style of football. Tainan is particularly strong at home and will aim to control the game from the outset.

Dewa United

The 'Guardian Warriors' are an ambitious project from Indonesia, testing their strength on the international stage for the first time. The team relies on a mix of experienced local players and quality foreign legionnaires. In an away match against an experienced opponent, Dewa United is likely to adopt a cautious strategy, focusing on quick counter-attacks.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Tainan City (4-3-3): Pan Wen-chieh; Chen Wei-chuan, Fong Shao-chi, Simizu, Costa; Ko-Chi, Kim Sung-min, Lin Kai-hsun; Mauricio, An Yong-joon, Pai Shao-yu.
  • Dewa United (4-2-3-1): Stevens; Ady Setiawan, Mitrevski, Sukarja, Zaenuri; Kolovos, Febrianto; Hamdi, Egy, Fadhil; Alex.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although the Indonesian league is considered stronger, Tainan City's experience and home-field advantage make them slight favorites. A tactical battle with a low number of scoring chances is expected.

  • Main Prediction: Tainan City Double Chance (1X). The hosts are more experienced in Asian tournaments and should secure at least a point at home.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Dewa United's debut away match will likely force them to play defensively, which does not suggest a high-scoring game.

Khalidiya vs Al Ahli: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Bahraini derby in the AFC Champions League Two group stage, as Khalidiya hosts Al Ahli from Manama. This is a fierce rivalry between two opponents who are very familiar with each other from their domestic league and are now settling scores on the continental stage.

Kick-off: October 29, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK)
Stadium: Khalifa Sports City Stadium, Isa Town
Competition: AFC Champions League Two

Khalidiya vs Al Ahli: Match Preview

Khalidiya, the reigning Bahraini champions, come into the match as the nominal favorites, especially given their consistent recent results. Al Ahli, one of the country's most decorated clubs, is always a formidable opponent, particularly in a derby. Matches between these teams are traditionally tight and hard-fought, often ending in draws or with a narrow victory for one side, such as the recent 1-1 draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Khalidiya

The champions of Bahrain play a very organized and tactically astute brand of football. The team focuses on solid defensive play and quick transitions into attack. Khalidiya has been on a long unbeaten run in their domestic league and will be looking to translate that success to the Asian stage. A win in the derby could be a key step towards advancing from the group.

Al Ahli Manama

Al Ahli is an experienced competitor that may not have the same consistency as their opponent today but compensates with character and dedication. The team will be highly motivated for the game against the champions and will try to impose a physical style with a lot of duels. Al Ahli's success will largely depend on their ability to convert their chances on the counter-attack.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Khalidiya (4-2-3-1): Al-Dosari; Adel, Al-Haza'a, Baqer, Isa; Al-Hardan, Abduljabbar; Madan, Helal, Dhiab; Abdullatif.
  • Al Ahli (4-4-2): Al-Mishkhas; Saeed, Al-Jassim, Al-Safi, Redha; Al-Aswad, Hubail; Jasim, Al-Shaikh, Ali; Thiago.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A classic derby is expected – a tight game with a lot of tactical battles and a minimum of scoring opportunities. The stakes are very high, so both teams are likely to play cautiously.

  • Main Prediction: Khalidiya Double Chance (1X). The champions appear to be the more stable team and should at least avoid defeat in this crucial match.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Derbies between these teams are rarely high-scoring, and recent head-to-head encounters confirm this trend.

Roma vs Parma: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Serie A Matchday 10 fixture, as AS Roma hosts Parma at the Stadio Olimpico. This is a clash between one of the league leaders, looking to bounce back from recent setbacks, and a solid mid-table side that has returned to the top flight and shown a resilient character.

Kick-off: October 30, 2025, 17:30 UTC (20:30 MSK)
Stadium: Stadio Olimpico, Rome
Competition: Serie A, Matchday 10

Roma vs Parma: Match Preview

Roma, under Gian Piero Gasperini, comes into the match in 4th place but on a two-game losing streak in the league. In the last round, the 'Wolves' lost 1-0 to Inter. Parma, back in Serie A, sits in 15th place and is one of the league's draw specialists, having drawn four of their last five matches. In the previous round, the 'Crusaders' drew 1-1 with Empoli. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Romans: Roma is unbeaten in the last 11 meetings with Parma, winning 9 of them.

Team Form and Analysis

Roma

The 'Giallorossi' boast one of the best defenses in the league, having conceded only 5 goals in 9 matches. However, the team has struggled with finishing in recent games. Roma is traditionally strong at home and will be highly motivated to end their losing streak in front of their fans. In attack, hopes are pinned on Paulo Dybala and Artem Dovbyk.

Parma

Fabio Pecchia's team plays very organized football, especially in defense, but has immense difficulties in attack, having scored the fewest goals in the league – just 6. Parma has yet to win away from home this season but has managed three draws. In Rome, the 'Crusaders' are likely to rely on a deep defense and counter-attacks.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Roma (3-4-2-1): Svilar; Mancini, Ndicka, Hermoso; Çelik, Cristante, Koné, Angeliño; Soulé, Pellegrini; Dovbyk.
  • Parma (4-2-3-1): Suzuki; Del Prato, Osorio, Balogh, Valeri; Estévez, Bernabé; Man, Sohm, Mihăilă; Bonny.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Roma is the undisputed favorite for this encounter. The quality of players, home advantage, and head-to-head statistics all point in favor of the Romans. It will be extremely difficult for Parma to contain the motivated hosts.

  • Main Prediction: Roma to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. The 'Wolves' should break their losing streak with a convincing victory over an underdog struggling in attack.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Roma to Win to Nil. Given Roma's solid defense and Parma's toothless attack, a clean-sheet victory for the hosts looks very likely.

Juventus vs Udinese: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Italian Serie A match, in which Juventus hosts Udinese at the Allianz Stadium in Turin. This is a showdown between one of the main Scudetto contenders and a team from the bottom half of the league table.

Kick-off: October 29, 2025, 17:30 UTC (20:30 MSK)
Stadium: Allianz Stadium, Turin
Competition: Serie A

Juventus vs Udinese: Match Preview

Juventus enters the match as the undisputed favorite. 'The Old Lady' is in the thick of the title race and rarely drops points on home soil. Udinese, on the other hand, has more modest goals, trying to maintain a safe distance from the relegation zone. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Turin club: Juventus has won the last six encounters, with the most recent meeting ending in a convincing 3-0 victory for the 'Bianconeri'.

Team Form and Analysis

Juventus

Thiago Motta's team plays a pragmatic and highly effective style of football, built on the foundation of the most solid defense in Serie A. At home, the 'Bianconeri' are yet to lose this season. In attack, the main threat comes from Dušan Vlahović, who is in excellent goal-scoring form. Juventus will be aiming for another convincing victory to continue their pursuit of the league leaders.

Udinese

The 'Little Zebras' have shown inconsistent results. The team struggles in matches against top clubs, especially away from home, where they rarely manage to pick up points. In Turin, Udinese will likely focus on a deep defensive setup and try to capitalize on rare counter-attacking opportunities, relying on the skill of their leader, Lazar Samardžić.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Juventus (3-5-2): Di Gregorio; Gatti, Bremer, Danilo; Weah, McKennie, Locatelli, Rabiot, Cambiaso; Yıldız, Vlahović.
  • Udinese (3-5-1-1): Okoye; Pérez, Bijol, Kristensen; Ehizibue, Samardžić, Walace, Payero, Kamara; Thauvin; Lucca.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The difference in class and current form between the teams is too significant to expect an upset. Juventus, on their home ground, should be in complete control of the game and secure a victory.

  • Main Prediction: Juventus to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. The Turin side is a class above and should defeat this opponent at home by a margin of at least two goals.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Juventus to Win to Nil. The Bianconeri's formidable defense and their dominant head-to-head record suggest a victory without conceding.

Lorient vs PSG: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this French Ligue 1 match, as Lorient hosts the reigning champions and current league leaders, Paris Saint-Germain, at the Stade du Moustoir. This is a clash between a team fighting for survival and the main powerhouse of French football.

Kick-off: October 29, 2025, 18:00 UTC (21:00 MSK)
Stadium: Stade du Moustoir, Lorient
Competition: Ligue 1

Lorient vs PSG: Match Preview

PSG comes into the match as the undisputed favorite, leading the league table and showcasing a phenomenal attacking game. Lorient, on the other hand, is in the lower part of the table and is in desperate need of points to move away from the relegation zone. Despite the difference in class, 'Les Merlus' have sensationally defeated PSG at the Parc des Princes in the recent past, which adds a layer of intrigue. However, the overall head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Parisians, who have won the majority of their encounters, including the last one 4-1.

Team Form and Analysis

Lorient

Régis Le Bris's team relies on a compact defense and quick counter-attacks. On their artificial turf, Lorient can cause problems for any opponent, but the team lacks consistency and quality, especially in matches against top clubs. Their main issue is a weak defense, which is one of the worst in the league.

PSG

The Parisians, under the management of Luis Enrique, are in excellent form, securing victories in both the league and the Champions League. The team boasts a powerful squad, with Kylian Mbappé shining in attack as the league's top scorer. PSG will be aiming for another convincing victory to strengthen their lead. Some squad rotation is possible following their midweek European fixture.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Lorient (5-4-1): Mvogo; Kalulu, Laporte, Talbi, Touré, Le Goff; Faivre, Abergel, Bakayoko, Ponceau; Kroupi.
  • PSG (4-3-3): Donnarumma; Hakimi, Marquinhos, Škriniar, Hernández; Zaïre-Emery, Ugarte, Vitinha; Dembélé, Ramos, Mbappé.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The difference in class between the two teams is colossal. Although Lorient is capable of surprises, PSG is the absolute favorite and should be in complete control of the game.

  • Main Prediction: PSG to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. The Parisians are a class above and should defeat the underdog by a margin of at least two goals.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 3.0 Goals. PSG's attacking power and Lorient's defensive problems suggest a high-scoring match.

Liverpool vs Crystal Palace: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this EFL Cup Round of 16 match, as Liverpool hosts Crystal Palace at the legendary Anfield. This is a clash between two Premier League teams where the hosts, despite expected squad rotation, are considered the clear favorites.

Kick-off: October 29, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK)
Stadium: Anfield, Liverpool
Competition: English League Cup, Round of 16

Liverpool vs Crystal Palace: Match Preview

Liverpool comes into this match looking to build on their recent European victory, which broke a losing streak in the league. For Arne Slot's team, the League Cup is a good opportunity to regain confidence and give playing time to squad players. Crystal Palace, on the other hand, has slowed down after an impressive start to the season but remains a very dangerous opponent with a potent attacking line. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the Merseyside club: Liverpool has won the last 13 consecutive encounters against Palace in all competitions.

Team Form and Analysis

Liverpool

Arne Slot is expected to make extensive changes to his lineup. Caoimhín Kelleher is likely to start in goal, while young players and those who don't feature regularly in the Premier League, such as Harvey Elliott, Curtis Jones, and Cody Gakpo, will get a chance to shine. Despite the changes, the Anfield factor and the high quality of the backup players make Liverpool the favorites.

Crystal Palace

Oliver Glasner's team comfortably defeated Fulham in the previous cup round. The Eagles possess a very creative attacking group with Eberechi Eze, Michael Olise, and Jean-Philippe Mateta, who are capable of causing problems for any defense. The visitors will also likely rotate their squad slightly, but their lineup will be closer to full strength, as the cup competition is an important goal for Palace.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Liverpool (4-3-3): Kelleher; Bradley, Quansah, Gomez, Tsimikas; Elliott, McConnell, Jones; Doak, Gakpo, Diogo Jota.
  • Crystal Palace (3-4-3): Henderson; Ward, Tomkins, Richards; Muñoz, Hughes, Lerma, Mitchell; Olise, Eze, Mateta.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the expected rotation, Liverpool at Anfield is too strong. Their total dominance in head-to-head meetings and squad depth should see them through to the next round. However, Palace's attack is unlikely to leave the field without a goal.

  • Main Prediction: Liverpool to Win. The Merseysiders should extend their impressive winning streak in matches against the Eagles.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both Teams to Score & Over 2.5 Goals. Liverpool almost always scores at home, and Palace's creative attack is capable of breaching even a rotated home defense.

Internazionale vs Fiorentina: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the headline match of the 10th round of Italian Serie A, as Inter Milan hosts Fiorentina at the Stadio Giuseppe Meazza (San Siro). This is a classic showdown between two ambitious teams from the top half of the league table, both fighting for European qualification spots.

Kick-off: October 29, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK)
Stadium: Stadio Giuseppe Meazza (San Siro), Milan
Competition: Serie A, Matchday 10

Inter vs Fiorentina: Match Preview

Inter comes into the match as one of the league leaders and the clear favorite. The Nerazzurri are playing powerful football and rarely drop points on their home turf. Fiorentina, in turn, is also in good form and aiming to solidify their position in the Champions League zone. The head-to-head history at the San Siro is entirely in Inter's favor: the Milan side has won the last seven home matches against 'La Viola' and is unbeaten against them at home in 13 consecutive games.

Team Form and Analysis

Internazionale

Simone Inzaghi's side is in excellent form, performing confidently in both Serie A and the Champions League. Inter boasts one of the best attacking lines in Europe, led by captain Lautaro Martínez. The team is consistently picking up points and will be aiming for another victory to strengthen their position in the title race. The only factor that could affect the hosts is potential fatigue after a midweek European fixture.

Fiorentina

'La Viola,' under the management of Raffaele Palladino, plays an exciting and bold style of football. The team scores plenty of goals, and their attacking leader, Nicolás González, is in fine form. Fiorentina has been successful in recent rounds and will try to impose their game even at the San Siro. However, the team sometimes lacks defensive stability in matches against top opponents, and their record at Inter's ground is daunting.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Inter (3-5-2): Sommer; Pavard, de Vrij, Bastoni; Dumfries, Barella, Çalhanoğlu, Mkhitaryan, Dimarco; Thuram, Martínez.
  • Fiorentina (4-2-3-1): Terracciano; Dodô, Milenković, Martínez Quarta, Biraghi; Arthur, Duncan; González, Bonaventura, Sottil; Retegui.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

This is expected to be one of the most interesting matches of the round. Inter is the favorite due to their superior quality, home-field advantage, and total dominance in head-to-head encounters at the San Siro.

  • Main Prediction: Internazionale to Win. The Nerazzurri are too strong at home and should extend their winning streak in matches against Fiorentina.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Both teams practice attacking football, and despite the statistics, Fiorentina is capable of scoring a consolation goal.

Wolverhampton Wanderers vs Chelsea: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this EFL Cup Round of 16 match, as Wolverhampton Wanderers host Chelsea at Molineux Stadium. This is a clash between two Premier League teams with vastly different league ambitions but a shared goal of advancing in the cup.

Kick-off: October 29, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK)
Stadium: Molineux Stadium, Wolverhampton
Competition: English League Cup, Round of 16

Wolverhampton Wanderers vs Chelsea: Match Preview

Wolverhampton enters the match sitting at the bottom of the Premier League table, with their only solace this season coming from their performances in the League Cup, where they have secured two victories. Chelsea, in contrast, is in good form, having won four consecutive matches in all competitions. The Blues are aiming for a quarter-final spot and will be the favorites despite playing away. The head-to-head record in domestic cup competitions favors Chelsea, who have won four of the last five encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Wolverhampton Wanderers

Vítor Pereira's side is in a deep crisis in the league, having collected just two points from nine matches. However, in the League Cup, Wolves have managed to get past West Ham and Everton. They are unbeaten in their last seven home matches in this competition. Despite their dire Premier League form, the team will be eager to put up a fight and redeem themselves in front of their home fans.

Chelsea

Enzo Maresca's team has found a good rhythm. In the previous round of the League Cup, the Blues defeated Lincoln City 2-1. The manager is expected to rotate his squad, giving a chance to young players and those who have had less game time. Specifically, Malo Gusto, Wesley Fofana, Andrey Santos, and Roméo Lavia are expected to start. Chelsea has significant personnel issues: Levi Colwill, Cole Palmer, and Benoît Badiashile are injured, while Mykhailo Mudryk is suspended.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Wolverhampton (3-5-2): King; Mosquera, Dawson, Bueno; Semedo, Doyle, Gomes, Traoré, Aït-Nouri; Sarabia, Strand Larsen.
  • Chelsea (4-2-3-1): Petrović; Gusto, Fofana, Hato, Chilwell; Santos, Lavia; Madueke, Gallagher, Gittens; George.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Even though Chelsea is likely to field a mixed lineup, the difference in class and current form between the teams is too significant. Wolverhampton is in a deep crisis, and even their home advantage is unlikely to help them overcome Chelsea's motivated reserves.

  • Main Prediction: Chelsea to Win. The visitors should advance to the next round, even with a rotated squad.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Six of the last seven head-to-head meetings have seen over 2.5 goals, and Chelsea has scored at least twice in their last three games against Wolves.

Arsenal vs Brighton & Hove Albion: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of one of the most intriguing matches of the EFL Cup Round of 16, as Arsenal hosts Brighton & Hove Albion at the Emirates. This is a clash between two Premier League teams that practice an attacking, possession-based style of football, which promises an entertaining contest.

Kick-off: October 29, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK)
Stadium: Emirates Stadium, London
Competition: English League Cup, Round of 16

Arsenal vs Brighton: Match Preview

Arsenal comes into the match in magnificent form, leading the Premier League and boasting the best defense in England. Mikel Arteta's side will be looking to continue their successful run in the cup competition. Brighton, after a slight dip in form, has regained momentum in recent matches. The 'Seagulls' are known for their bold style of play and their ability to cause problems for top clubs. The head-to-head history is quite balanced, but recently Brighton has become a bogey team for the Gunners, winning three of the last five encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Arsenal

Mikel Arteta is expected to rotate his squad, giving a chance to players who have had less game time in the Premier League. Aaron Ramsdale, Fábio Vieira, Reiss Nelson, and Eddie Nketiah are likely to start. Despite this, Arsenal has enough squad depth to field a very competitive team. The Gunners are particularly strong at home and will look to dominate the game.

Brighton & Hove Albion

Fabian Hürzeler's side will also likely make some changes, but their lineup will be closer to full strength, as the League Cup is an important competition for Brighton. The 'Seagulls' control possession and are not afraid to play their football even at the grounds of the top teams. Their attacking line, featuring players like João Pedro and Ansu Fati, is capable of troubling any defense.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Arsenal (4-3-3): Ramsdale; Tomiyasu, Kiwior, Gabriel, Zinchenko; Jorginho, Vieira, Smith Rowe; Nelson, Nketiah, Martinelli.
  • Brighton (4-2-3-1): Steele; Veltman, van Hecke, Dunk, Igor; Gilmour, Baleba; March, João Pedro, Fati; Welbeck.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite potential rotation, Arsenal is the favorite due to their home-field advantage and greater squad depth. However, Brighton's adventurous style and their success in recent head-to-head meetings make this match unpredictable and likely high-scoring.

  • Main Prediction: Arsenal to Win. The Gunners at the Emirates should prove their class and seek revenge for recent defeats against Brighton.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both Teams to Score. Both teams play attacking football and are unlikely to leave the pitch without finding the net.

Join us for the live broadcast of this fourth-round EFL Cup match, where Championship side Swansea City hosts Premier League giants Manchester City. For the hosts, it's a chance to test themselves against a top club, while the Citizens are expected to rotate their squad.

Kick-off: October 29, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK)
Stadium: Swansea.com Stadium, Swansea
Competition: EFL Cup, 4th Round

Swansea City vs Manchester City: Match Preview

Swansea approaches this match in high spirits after a sensational comeback in the previous round to beat Nottingham Forest 3-2. In their last league game, the Swans also secured a 2-1 victory over Norwich City. Manchester City, in contrast, lost their last Premier League match 1-0 to Aston Villa. The head-to-head history is entirely in favor of the visitors, with City winning all of the last six meetings.

Team Form and Analysis

Swansea City

The Welsh team has shown great character in cup competitions. The Swans are playing without pressure as the underdogs, which could work to their advantage. In attack, Zan Vipotnik stands out, having scored in recent matches and already surpassed his goal tally from last year. The absence of injured defender Ricardo Santos is a significant blow.

Manchester City

Pep Guardiola is expected to heavily rotate his squad following a tough Premier League fixture and with more games ahead. The participation of Erling Haaland, who picked up a knock, and Rodri is in doubt. This provides an opportunity for fringe players like Omar Marmoush, Khusanov, and Rayan Aït-Nouri to impress. Even City's second-string lineup poses a formidable threat due to the high quality of the players.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Swansea City (5-4-1): Fisher; Key, Casey, Burgess, Samuels-Smith; Franco, Galbraith, Benson, Yalcouye, Ji-Sung Eom; Vipotnik.
  • Manchester City (4-2-3-1): Ortega; Lewis, Akanji, Khusanov, Aït-Nouri; Gomez, Kovačić; Bobb, Palmer, Doku; Marmoush.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the expected rotation for Manchester City and Swansea's cup spirit, the difference in class between the two sides is colossal. The visitors should dominate the match and secure a comfortable victory.

  • Main Prediction: Manchester City to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. Even a rotated City squad is a class above their Championship opponents.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Swansea has shown they can score against Premier League teams, and City's attack, regardless of who plays, is capable of scoring multiple goals.

Newcastle United vs Tottenham Hotspur: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of one of the most high-profile matches of the EFL Cup Round of 16, as Newcastle United hosts Tottenham Hotspur at St. James' Park. This is a battle between two ambitious clubs from the top tier of the Premier League, both aiming for the highest honors in all competitions.

Kick-off: October 29, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK)
Stadium: St. James' Park, Newcastle upon Tyne
Competition: English League Cup, Round of 16

Newcastle United vs Tottenham: Match Preview

Newcastle comes into the match having successfully navigated the previous round against Manchester City. Eddie Howe's team is traditionally powerful on their home turf, backed by their deafening supporters. Tottenham, under Ange Postecoglou, is playing exciting attacking football and is in excellent form in the league. In their last meeting at St. James' Park, the Magpies thrashed Spurs 6-1, and the London side will surely be eager for revenge.

Team Form and Analysis

Newcastle United

The Magpies rely on high pressing, intensity, and quick attacks. Eddie Howe is expected to rotate his squad, giving opportunities to players who get less game time in the Premier League, such as Tino Livramento, Matt Targett, Lewis Hall, and Harvey Barnes. Despite this, Newcastle will maintain their aggressive style, especially at home, where the team rarely loses.

Tottenham Hotspur

Spurs will also resort to rotation. Ange Postecoglou is likely to give a chance to players like Brennan Johnson, Giovani Lo Celso, and Pierre-Emile Højbjerg. Tottenham will not deviate from their attacking style with high ball possession. However, their high defensive line could be vulnerable to Newcastle's swift counter-attacks.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Newcastle (4-3-3): Dúbravka; Livramento, Lascelles, Burn, Hall; Longstaff, Anderson, Miley; Murphy, Wilson, Barnes.
  • Tottenham (4-2-3-1): Forster; Emerson, Dier, van de Ven, Davies; Højbjerg, Skipp; Johnson, Lo Celso, Gil; Richarlison.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A vibrant and high-scoring match is expected, despite the squad rotations. Both teams practice attacking football, and their recent head-to-head encounters have been rich in goals. The home-field advantage makes Newcastle slight favorites.

  • Main Prediction: Newcastle Double Chance (1X). At St. James' Park, the Magpies are capable of defeating any opponent, and even with a rotated squad, they look at least as strong as Spurs.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both Teams to Score & Over 2.5 Goals. The styles of both teams and the history of their rivalry, especially last season's 6-1 thrashing, suggest an open game with plenty of chances and goals.
